description: This file is a command-line interface (CLI) script for a universal project initialization tool, handling argument parsing, project configuration creation, template management, and output formatting.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Represents the template initialization information including commands, environment configurations, scripts, and style options.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Contains configuration details for a project such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class representing different project types, with a method for conversion from string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Handles creation of project templates and the initialization process based on project configuration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig instance from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info without full user input.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs formatted JSON with success status, message, and optional template configuration.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a given project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Processes request to retrieve the run command for a specific project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that handles CLI argument parsing and project initialization or retrieval of run command.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
